violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE DRAIN AND THOROUGHLY CLEAN/SANITIZE THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. Inchin's Bamboo Garden (Inspection Date: 07/20/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: OBSERVED BAR UTENSILS IN A CONTAINER OF COLD WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH THE PIC. PIC WILL KEEP BAR UTENSILS IN A DRY CONTAINER IN THE FUTURE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE ENSURE ICE MACHINE IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED GARLIC IN OIL AT 50F ON COUNTER-TOP; OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 46-48F AND VEGETABLE FRITTERS AT 47F IN LEFT 2-DOOR PREP TOP; OBSERVED VEGETABLE DUMPLINGS AT 50F AND DICED TOMATOES AT 45F IN THE RIGHT 2-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED ALL FOOD ITEMS TO OTHER COOLERS/FREEZERS. PROPER THAWING AND PREP-TOP USAGE WAS DISCUSSED WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS IN PREP TOPS ARE STORED IN THE PREP-TOP, NOT ON TOP.

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. OBSERVED LACK OF WORKING REFRIGERATION AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: PIC AGREED TO VOLUNTARILY CLOSE DUE TO LACK OF WORKING REFRIGERATION. violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES, COOLING PROCESSES AND PARAMETERS, UNIT TEMPERATURES, AND HANDWASHING as it relates to their assigned duties.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. PLEASE ENSURE PROPER FOOD TEMPERATURES AND HANDWASHING PROCEDURES ARE DISCUSSED WITH THE STAFF PRIOR TO THE SECOND FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM OBSERVED ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING PROCEDURES NEED TO BE REVIEWED WITH STAFF AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED AT TWO HANDWASHING SINKS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE ALWAYS PROVIDED AT ALL HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE FRENCH FRIES IN THE TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION WITH STAFF. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED PANEER AT 45F AND PANEER MASALA AT 47F IN THE RIGHT TWO DOOR PREP TOP MADE THE NIGHT PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EHS REVIEWED PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS WITH PIC. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE COOLING FOODS COOL FROM 70F TO 41F WITHIN 4 HOURS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED MULTIPLE BATCHES OF COOKED PASTA AT 76-90F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER MADE MORE THAN 2 HOURS PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED NOODLES DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS SHOULD COOL FROM 135F TO 70F WITIHN 2 HOURS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SAMOSAS AT 55F, PANEER AT 51F, PANEER #2 AT 55F, AND SPRING ROLLS AT 64F IN THE TWO-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER. OBSERVED FRIED CAULIFLOWER AT 49F, CHICKEN WINGS AT 49F, AND FRIED PANEER AT 52F IN LEFT 2-DOOR PREP TOP. OBSERVED DICED TOMATOES T 45F, CUT CABBAGE AT 51F, BEAN SPROUTS AT 53-55F, CABBAGE AND CARROT MIX AT 57F, AND GARLIC IN OIL AT 66F IN RIGHT 2-DOOR PREP TOP. OBSERVED RICE AT 54F, PANEER AT 48F, CABBAGE AT 50F, MILK AT 47F, AND BEAN SPROUTS AT 48F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING SYSTEM IN PLACE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS REVIEWED DATE MARKING REQUIREMENTS WITH THE FACILITY. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF SECOND FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED LARGE PORTIONS OF COOLING PASTA/RICE IN WALK-IN COOLER WITH LIDS AND TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER COOLING METHODS WITH THE STAFF. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED NO WORKING CONTAINERS/BOTTLES LABELED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ANY FOOD ITEMS NOT IN ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER IS LABELED.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: HANDWASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN NEAR HOT WATER HEATER IS BROKEN, AND CANNOT SUPPLY HOT WATER.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC WILL ENSURE HANDWASHING SINK IS REPAIRED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW BEEF IN LEFT TWO-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS RAW MEATS SHOULD BE ORGANIZED PER COOK TEMPERATURE.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: OBSERVED CHEMICAL DISWASHING MACHINE SUPPLYING SANITIZER AT A CONCENTRATION OF 10PPM.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dischmachine so that food contact surfaces are exposed to sanitizer for the required amount of time per the data plate. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food contact surfaces. PIC SET UP THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION AND PLACED A WORK ORDER FOR DISHWASHING MACHINE. PIC UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD NOT BE USED TO SANITIZE DISHWARE UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED DUMPLINGS TO THE FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD NEVER BE STORED ON TOP OF OTHER FOODS IN PREP TOPS.
